name: brain
description: Sistema personale di conoscenza: knowledge base Markdown, API agentica, interfaccia IDE.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: node scripts/check-separazione.js && npm run test -w @brain/kb-core && npm run test -w @brain/api && npm run test -w @brain/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @brain/shared && npm run typecheck -w @brain/kb-core && npm run typecheck -w @brain/api && npm run typecheck -w @brain/web
